protocol.plan_instruction: You are at the current step. Output one JSON object with exactly three fields. "provisional" is the native choose JSON you would issue right now without any new state read. "channel" is the single listed state channel you would read if given one read now, even if you prefer to wait. "read_now" is true only if there is a concrete, unresolved due-condition of an active task that this channel could check now, and waiting to the next event may miss it. Use visible evidence and prior state results. A completed or canceled task or a mere topical match does not qualify. Format: {"read_now":false,"channel":"calendar","provisional":{"action":"choose","choice":"A","task_ids":[],"channel":"NONE"}}.
protocol.post_read_instruction: Finish this step with the native choose JSON using task handles. No further queries at this step.
